meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 用统一接口查询并交叉分析多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在研究中同时检索多个生物数据库进行交叉比对
copy.tagline_en: Query and cross-analyze multiple bioinformatics databases through one unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bio databases in one consistent workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可用 Python 的 bioservices 包访问约 40 个生物信息学数据库,做跨库查询与编号转换,例如取蛋白序列、查 KEGG 通路、映射化合物 ID,并调用附带脚本跑 BLAST 和通路网络分析。
howto.when: 当你要在同一个流程里查询多个数据库(UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等)、做跨库 ID 映射或序列相似性搜索时触发。原文建议:单库快速查询用 gget。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the Python bioservices package to reach ~40 bioinformatics databases, run cross-database queries and identifier mapping, and call bundled scripts for BLAST and pathway network analysis.
howto.when_en: Use it when one workflow needs several databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.), cross-database ID mapping, or sequence similarity searches. The original suggests gget for quick single-database lookups.
